function.name: get_cpu_metrics
function.description: Return CPU utilization breakdown (user/system/softirq/iowait/steal), run-queue length, load average, per-CPU hotspots, memory pressure (PSI) and cgroup CPU throttling counters for a host.

host.description: Host name, e.g. web-2. Omit for the affected service host.

function.name: get_network_metrics
function.description: Return NIC and TCP statistics: packets/s, rx/tx drops, ring-buffer overruns, TCP retransmissions, RTT, conntrack usage.

function.name: get_scheduler_latency
function.description: Return run-queue (scheduling) delay: how long runnable tasks wait for a CPU, measured from sched_wakeup to sched_switch.

cpu.description: Logical CPU id. Omit for all CPUs.

function.name: get_recent_logs
function.description: Return recent log lines (including kernel messages) for a service.

function.name: run_experiment
function.description: Run a controlled experiment in the isolated lab: baseline measurement or a fault injection.
